issues.description: Annexure 1 numbers the inheritance figures 8.1–8.4 and the Unit 9 figures 9.1–9.9, whereas the unit text captions them 8.2, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and 9.1–9.5, 9.7, 9.8, 9.9, 9.12, and gives page numbers that differ from the text.
